comments.body: The fcrepo-camel-webapp integration tests pull in the "standard" fcrepo-webapp warfile, and at least one of the projects (fcrepo-indexing-solr) relies on fcrepo-transform to be part of that war. Rather than using the maven-jetty plugin to startup a fedora instance, using spring should allow the integration tests to specify the fcrepo-transform module, if it is required.

Are we changing the groupId for the new external fcrepo-transform module?

I am realizing that this may require more Maven knowledge than I have available to me. So if this is going to be more complex than cribbing from fcrepo-camel, I may defer to another.

But for right now do we want option a)

 <groupId>org.fcrepo.transform</groupId>
  <artifactId>fcrepo-transform</artifactId>

or option b

 <groupId>org.fcrepo.exts.transform</groupId>
  <artifactId>fcrepo-transform</artifactId>

Option B obviously requires more work, but is it worth it? Or will it cause more trouble for other modules (like fcrepo-camel).
